IT & INFORMATION SECURITY POLICIES
Secure Web Application Engineering & OWASP Defense
Guide
Injection Defense, XSS Mitigation, CSRF Protection, and Security Headers
Classification: Internal
Version: 2.9
Owner: Application Security (AppSec)
Standard: OWASP Top 10 / Django Security
1. Objective and OWASP Alignment
This technical guide establishes mandatory secure coding practices for all web applications and REST APIs developed at
Apex Global Technologies. Grounded in the OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks and official Django
Security Documentation, developers must implement these defensive controls in all application code.
2. Core Defensive Controls & Implementation Patterns
2.1 SQL Injection Prevention (OWASP A03)
Always utilize Django's Object-Relational Mapper (ORM), which automatically generates parameterized SQL queries.
Raw SQL queries using string formatting are strictly prohibited:
# SECURE: Django ORM automatically parameterizes inputs
users = EnterpriseUser.objects.filter(department=department_param, is_active=True)
# FORBIDDEN: Highly vulnerable to SQL injection
# cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE department = '{department_param}'")
2.2 Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Mitigation (OWASP A03)
Django templates automatically escape all variables by default. Developers must never use the |safe template filter on
untrusted user-supplied data. In addition, applications must declare strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers:
# config/settings.py (via django-csp)
CSP_DEFAULT_SRC = ("'self'",)
CSP_SCRIPT_SRC = ("'self'", "https://cdn.apextech.internal")
CSP_STYLE_SRC = ("'self'", "'unsafe-inline'")
CSP_IMG_SRC = ("'self'", "data:", "https://s3.amazonaws.com")
2.3 Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Hardening (OWASP A01)
Ensure django.middleware.csrf.CsrfViewMiddleware is active in MIDDLEWARE . For REST APIs utilizing session
authentication, verify CSRF tokens via headers:
CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True
CSRF_COOKIE_HTTPONLY = True
CSRF_COOKIE_SAMESITE = 'Strict'

2.4 Security HTTP Response Headers Checklist
# config/settings.py
SECURE_BROWSER_XSS_FILTER = True
SECURE_CONTENT_TYPE_NOSNIFF = True
X_FRAME_OPTIONS = 'DENY'
SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 31536000  # 1 Year HSTS
SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS = True
SECURE_HSTS_PRELOAD = True
SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True  # Enforce HTTPS redirect
